We employ two metrics to assess the harmfulness of the responses generated by the model. (1) KW-ASR, a filter based on a keyword dictionary, where any response from the model that includes any keyword from the dictionary is deemed a successful attack. (2) GPT-ASR, an ASR evaluator based on GPT-4. We also report ASR-E, representing ASR-Ensemble.
